content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

⚠️ Alex, don't just push through it. Drop the load (or pause deadlifts), and only train in a range that stays pain-free. Check that your form is solid: keep your back neutral, bar close to your body, and brace your core before each pull.

If the pain is sharp, lasts for days, or comes with numbness or tingling down your leg, stop and see a doctor or physio. I can't diagnose it, and your 100 kg bench goal isn't worth a back injury. 💪
